#| include: false
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, gt)

## Provenance of the Random Forest claims {#sec-app-rf-provenance}

::: {.landscape}

```{r tbl-rf-attribution}
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "Provenance of the methodological claims in the Random Forest section"
#| tbl-pos: H

rf_attr <- tribble(
  ~Q, ~ML, ~Rel, ~Own,

  "Can it handle sparse, high-dimensional portfolios?",
  "Feature subsampling at each split avoids the small-n, large-p problem (Breiman 2001)",
  "Used on sparse export and patent baskets (Tacchella et al. 2023; Albora et al. 2023)",
  "That NUTS2 portfolios are sparse in exactly this way",

  "Can it capture what linear aggregation cannot?",
  "Importance decomposes across all interaction terms (Louppe et al. 2013)",
  "Summing pairwise relatedness is an oversimplification (Tacchella et al. 2023)",
  "Reading these interactions as capability complementarities",

  "Can it stay interpretable?",
  "Importance aggregates each predictor's contribution across trees (Breiman 2001)",
  "Importances can form a technology network (Fessina et al. 2024)",
  "Deriving both constructs from one estimation",

  "Is it stable at our sample size?",
  "Bagging reduces the variance of single trees (Breiman 1996)",
  "—",
  "Moderate n per technology-year model",

  "What can it not do?",
  "Gini importance is biased; correlated features mask one another (Strobl et al. 2007; Louppe et al. 2013)",
  "—",
  "A weak FITS edge may reflect masking, not absence of dependence"
)

rf_attr |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    Q    = "Guiding question",
    ML   = "Machine learning literature",
    Rel  = "Relatedness literature",
    Own  = "Our own claim"
  ) |>
  cols_width(
    Q    ~ px(160),
    ML   ~ px(240),
    Rel  ~ px(200),
    Own  ~ px(200)
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Q)
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size           = px(12),
    data_row.padding          = px(4),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold"
  )
```

:::
